name: Gamma Scalp (long single option, delta-hedged)
summary: Buy a single ATM option and continuously hedge its delta with shares, monetising realised volatility above the implied volatility paid.

legs.strike_rule: Short 50 shares initially to neutralise the call's +0.50 delta; rehedged as delta changes
legs.dte_rule: not applicable - the share hedge has no expiry

max_profit: Unbounded in theory: the sum of scalping profits (realised vol) minus the option's theta (implied vol paid)
max_loss: The option debit plus accumulated hedging slippage, if realised volatility comes in below the implied volatility paid. In practice hedging costs and spreads make this a professional's game.
breakevens: Profitable when realised volatility over the holding period exceeds the implied volatility paid, net of transaction costs

greeks.delta: maintained near 0 by the share hedge
greeks.gamma: positive - the entire source of P&L
greeks.theta: negative - the cost of carrying the gamma

when_to_use: When implied volatility is cheap relative to your realised-vol forecast: IVR < 20 AND 20-day realised volatility above current ATM implied volatility. Rare and short-lived.
entry_rules: Gate: 20-day realised volatility (close-to-close, annualised) exceeds current ATM IV by at least 3 volatility points
ATM call, 30-60 DTE, on an underlying with penny-wide shares and options (SPY/QQQ or a mega-cap)

Requires the ability to short shares - this system does not carry short equity, so the hedge must instead be implemented by buying an ATM PUT and hedging with LONG shares, or the strategy must be disabled
Hedge band defined in advance: rehedge whenever net position delta moves more than +/-15 deltas from zero
management_rules: Rehedge on the +/-15 delta band, not on a time schedule. Rehedging too often converts gamma profit into commission and spread
Track cumulative scalping P&L versus cumulative theta paid daily. If scalping P&L trails theta by more than 30% after 5 sessions, the vol forecast was wrong - close
Close at 21 DTE: gamma rises but theta rises faster, and the hedging band would have to tighten beyond what costs allow
Take profit when cumulative scalping P&L exceeds 1.5x the total theta expected over the remaining life
exit_rules: Close the option and flatten the share hedge together at 21 DTE, at the profit target, or at the 5-session underperformance check
Never carry the option into expiry week - auto-exercise would collide with the share hedge and produce an unintended net position
Flatten the share hedge in the SAME session the option is closed; an orphaned hedge is a naked directional stock position
assignment_risk: None on the long option. The operational risk is an orphaned share hedge after the option is closed, which silently becomes an unhedged directional stock position.
buying_power: Option debit plus share margin for the hedge. If the hedge requires shorting shares, the strategy is not available to this account and must be restructured around a long put plus long shares.
liquidity_needs: Very high. Requires penny-wide options and near-zero-cost share execution. Marginal for retail even on SPY.
common_mistakes: Rehedging on every tick and paying away the entire gamma profit; forgetting to flatten the share hedge when closing the option; running it when IV is not genuinely cheap versus realised.
zero_dte_notes: 0DTE gamma scalping is theoretically the highest-gamma version and practically the fastest way to pay away an account in spreads and commissions. Not recommended.
